title: A self-hosted Node.js deployment supports all Next.js features
statement: In Next.js 16.3.2, deploying as a Node.js server is a supported option and Node.js deployments support all Next.js features, without requiring a hosting platform or adapter.
notes: Bears on whether production mode is available to this product AT ALL. The tool is local-first and clonable (#1, #20, #32) — a deployment story that required a platform would make production mode unreachable regardless of what the PM preferred. It does not.
